digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI / pytest test suite auditing
propositions: An exhaustive audit of all pytest phases ≥1.0 second across three recent successful Gerrit Verify CI runs and a local current-main completeness pass identified 501 unique phases, with no individual phase exceeding 30 seconds; the sampled CI maximum was 22.63s and local maxima were 15.62s default and 21.96s integration.

Gerrit 1817 / commit 53efe2426e merged and closed maize-wintery-larva by removing exactly 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS and Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining them in Ubuntu 3.13, achieving ~8s macOS and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds savings with no new job, setup, or runner; no organic descendant patchset has yet measured the post-merge delta.

The 501-phase inventory grouped into eight semantic families (Git store/concurrency, plan/identity/signing lifecycle, deployment/reviewbot, import/packaging, analyzer grounding, partial clone, show under write burst, and editor/schema/platform contracts) with explicit keep/refactor/move dispositions, prior ticket audit links, and OSS precedent citations; no further node-level macOS-to-Ubuntu routing or job sharding is approved without repeated platform timings and equivalence proof.

External tool analyzers (250.81s default worker-phase), real Git/concurrency behavior, and platform-specific suites are retained; panpsychic-clever-hawk identified ~75s opportunity in per-test Git subprocess overhead but no consensus primitive for fidelity-preserving reduction was found across pytest, pip, Poetry, and pre-commit precedent.

Ranked next actions include approved implementation of songful-groovelike-horsemouse (test-only clocks/windows), followed by research/equivalence work on lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, and rival-ammoniacal-crustacean; N=3000 import benchmark and real concurrency seams remain monitored without changes to code, tests, CI, or workflows.
